name: Kuryuu Akane
source:
An enthusiastic girl who is part of the Track Club. She's the reckless, clumsy type who tends to act before she thinks, and tries to overcome everything through sheer enthusiasm and willpower. Everyone in the dorm sees Akane as a mascot of sorts.

While [url=/c64303]Reina[/url] teases her, [url=/c64302]Sylvie[/url] is nothing but affectionate. She is surprisingly susceptible to pressure and will yell "Auauh!" in no time flat.

"It's all right, [url=/c64498]Senpai[/url]! My heart is all fired up, so I am fine."

[From [url=http://kinkoi.nekonyansoft.com/chara05.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
